k-sym-BUNCOIN.title: BUNCOIN GTA 6 bank directory coins
k-sym-BUNCOIN.sourceSays: Posts say players spotted a BUNCOIN listing on the directory of the Piker Financial Center building in GTA 6 footage; accounts tie the $BUNCOIN tickers to it. Unverified.
k-sym-BUNCOIN.reason: Nov 18 post describes the Piker Financial Center directory in GTA 6 footage; Nov 19 post says BUNCOIN is listed there. Other posts are call-group shills, ignored; the first pool is about 26h old.
